# Vendored mlua0.12.2

The published README is retained unchanged in `README.upstream`. Its repository-relative links refer to the [upstream release](https://github.com/mlua-rs/mlua/tree/v0.12.2), rather than files bundled in the crate archive.

See [Ruster patch notes](RUSTER-PATCH.md) for provenance, the original MIT license and bounded Lua5.4 local-accessor extension.
